hook: TIMS Alwal, LB Nagar get a *June 2* deadline
hook_b: TIMS Alwal, LB Nagar get a *June 2* deadline
tldr: Revanth Reddy directed that TIMS Alwal and LB Nagar, Warangal super speciality hospital and NIMS expansion be completed and operational by June 2 next year.

beats.what: He called for a unified recruitment policy so doctors can move between TIMS Sanathnagar, Alwal and LB Nagar, per The Hindu.
beats.why: He wants Sanathnagar TIMS fully used to ease NIMS when beds are unavailable or surgeries delayed.
beats.care: Residents of Alwal and LB Nagar would get large government hospitals closer to home if deadlines hold.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Doctors may be hired from outside until regular TIMS recruitment is done, with funds released immediately.

cards.q: Which matters most for the new TIMS hospitals?

qs: Will staffing keep pace with the new beds?
How will patients be routed between NIMS and TIMS?

facts.t: Outpatients rose from *7 crore to 9 crore*, officials informed the CM.
Recruitment for *5,640* more health posts is underway, after 13,401 appointments.

viz.verdict: More public hospital beds, as reported by officials

watch: Whether TIMS Alwal and LB Nagar open by June 2, 2027.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: TIMS hospitals will be fully operational by June 2, says Chief Minister

fact: CM sets *June 2, 2027* deadline for TIMS Alwal and LB Nagar hospitals.
twist: Officials told him government hospital beds rose from *30,000 to 38,000*; new Osmania General Hospital is due by *Dec 2027*.
